title: Design System: 康复训练计时器

display.purpose: Primary Chinese instructions and phase labels.

shadows.name: equipment-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift the Start block and running scoreboard above the tile field.

motion.name: scoreboard-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal the running scoreboard from the left after Start.

components.name: Start Button
components.description: The single oversized action that unlocks speech and audio.
components.css: .ds-start { min-height: 180px; width: 100%; padding: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 26px; background: #f36a32; color: #041f32; font: 700 3rem/1 'Kaiti SC', STKaiti, KaiTi, serif; box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(4,31,50,.16), 0 4px 10px rgba(4,31,50,.1); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-start:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-start:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-start:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #041f32; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Reset Button
components.description: The sole running control for interruption and recovery.
components.css: .ds-reset { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #6e9da0; border-radius: 999px; background: #f7fbf9; color: #a32d20; font-weight: 800; } .ds-reset:hover { border-color: #a32d20; background: #fff3f0; } .ds-reset:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #041f32; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Scoreboard
components.description: The high-contrast running state for phase and countdown.
components.css: .ds-scoreboard { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .72fr 1fr; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 26px; background: #07324a; color: #f7fbf9; box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(4,31,50,.16); } .ds-scoreboard strong { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 180px; background: #041f32; color: #bde8e5; font: 700 3rem/1 'Kaiti SC', STKaiti, KaiTi, serif; } .ds-scoreboard span { display: grid; place-items: center; font: 800 6rem/.82 'Avenir Next Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The interface borrows the legibility, lane markers, and decisive timing language of a pool-deck pace board. It stays bright under ordinary training-room light and disappears once audio takes over.
keyCharacteristics: Chlorine tile and deep lane blue form the dominant field.
Safety orange is reserved for the action and active repetition.
Rope markers and split-time bars make progress physical rather than ornamental.

rules.name: The Safety Signal Rule
rules.body: Use orange only for the primary Start action and the active training marker so it never loses urgency.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: Phase, group, repetition, and remaining time must be understandable in one glance without reading explanatory copy.

dos: Do preserve orange for Start and the active repetition.
Do keep the fixed two-by-six lane visible whenever the session is running.
donts: Don't replace the scoreboard with a circular progress ring.
Don't add network-dependent fonts, images, icons, or effects.
